original_test_intent: Upgrade the installed AMDGPU driver to a specific approved newer version, reboot successfully, and verify the new module/ROCm stack and all GPUs function correctly.
original_method: Record current package/module/kernel/GPU state, validate the signed exact newer package set and compatibility, prepare rollback/OOB, execute pinned upgrade and DKMS/initramfs transaction, reboot once, prove version direction and complete module/GPU/link/log health.
manual_activity: OS/GPU owner approves exact newer package/support/rollback, supervises console reboot and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Current and exact approved newer versions
Expected GPU topology and post-upgrade matrix
Console/OOB, reboot deadline and old-version rollback plan
safety_requirements: Verify signed exact version and dependencies before root transaction
Retain old packages/kernel and rollback boot
Observe one reboot through independent console/OOB
Stop/recover on install/DKMS/boot/module/GPU anomaly; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Run pinned upgrade transaction and capture all changes
Perform one authorized reboot and comprehensive checks
Recover/report without selecting version or setting verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind current/target package versions, repo snapshot, DKMS/initramfs outputs and rollback artifacts in one upgrade manifest, followed by stable-identity all-GPU checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes 'newer' deterministic and proves the actual transition and recoverability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Fresh install or simple version display does not satisfy upgrade behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Package success before reboot does not prove new kernel module activation.

project_override_considerations: Engineering selects the exact supported newer stack and acceptable dependency/kernel changes plus rollback floor.
expected_evidence: Signed target packages/repo snapshot/checksums and transition diff
Console/OOB reboot timeline and target kernel
Post target version/module signature/binding/all-GPU rocm-smi/link evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines exact newer-version upgrade; DeepSeek is incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target packages and rollback inputs can be supplied.

review_improvement: Adds deterministic version direction, signed transaction diff and console-observed rollback-capable reboot to the upgrade.
independent_technical_reasoning: A repository may resolve 'newer' differently over time, and installed user-space ROCm can diverge from the kernel module actually loaded after reboot. Acceptance needs exact current/target versions, module build/signature/binding and all stable-mapped GPUs. Keeping the old package/kernel path intact is part of safe upgrade evidence, not an afterthought.
